title: VIXEN auto-discovery misses the assigned Undertow lane worktree
body: VIXEN auto-discovery checks .claude-worktrees/<lane>, but the existing assigned Undertow lane is under .claude/worktrees/<lane>; the real configure therefore selected the sibling checkout until UNDERTOW_ROOT was passed explicitly. Suggested consolidation: resolve both supported worktree layouts (or publish one canonical path) before codegen configure.

title: Queue replay key ignores environment overrides
body: The paired configure command replayed an older identical command and ignored the changed UNDERTOW_ROOT environment, selecting the wrong sibling checkout. The documented workaround was UT_QUEUE_REPLAY=0 for a fresh queued run. Suggested consolidation: include relevant environment overrides in replay identity or expose a safe fresh-run flag in the lane workflow.

title: Unfiltered VIXEN CTest mixes multi-minute capture jobs with fast unit tests
body: The required unfiltered ctest had 3255 discovered tests; one lookdev presentation test took 466.80 seconds and the next identical capture was still running for several minutes, while unrelated editor/upscaler baseline failures appeared earlier. Suggested consolidation: publish a bounded fast/full split or labels so facade/codegen lanes can validate required scope without an unbounded GPU capture tail.
